name: mmm.page
title: mmm.page
shortDescription: mmm.page allows users to create unique, drag-and-drop websites with ease. It's designed for anyone looking to build a personal corner on the internet, from link-in-bio pages to full portfolios and landing pages. Users can add text, images, GIFs, videos, and more to their pages, making it a versatile tool for creative expression. The platform encourages a messy, imperfect style, standing out in a sea of cookie-cutter website designs.
pros: Free tier available with essential features
Supports a wide range of content types
cons: May not suit traditional business needs
